g.text: Do you know much of death?
And here I thought *I* was morbid... Are you okay?
LOL. Lady, don't get me started. You?
You seriously need to get outside more often.
La Flaca and I know each other well
Even if sometimes I don't want to like her
But she shepherds the ones I care for
But you're a medic. Don't you heal people? How can you "respect" death?
Death isn't a person. It's a thing that happens.
You're thinking about it all wrong
Do you blame her for ending your pain?
Was it her fault you suffered or was it the ones who hurt you to blame
My job is to make sure she takes people when it is their time
Not until she rips them from my hands
And not a damn second sooner
I make sure she knows she is welcome
She is not to be feared, but respected
When I was in Duviri, and I knew I was about to die, sometimes it was a relief to know it'd be over soon.
I guess part of me understands that. Even if I don't like the idea of dying.
I am... going to stop this conversation, now.
That no matter how badly it was about to hurt, the darkness would come and it'd be done.
To make sure La Flaca is certain in who she is taking
And that she ONLY gets who she needs
But I also knew I was going to come back.
But I don't think it means everybody should die. lol
We've all seen her sent loved ones too soon by the actions of others...
Maybe not as literally as you jaja
Though... now we are fantasmas, too
Caught in the same endless cycle as you were...
I need to go back to work
